levels.description:
ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>; when there are Wanted enemies on the battlefield, consumes a bullet to take aim for up to <@ba.vup>{attack@aim_duration}</>s before firing a shot that ignores Dodge (while aiming, ATK gradually increases from <@ba.vup>{attack@main_atk_scale:0%}</> to <@ba.vup>{attack@fin_atk_scale:0%}</>; if ATK is higher than the sum of target's remaining HP and DEF, stops aiming and immediately fires)
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)</>
